verdict.rationale: Rootly's Workflows are documented as its automation engine: you define trigger events, run conditions and actions, and they run automatically. A reference covers 152 action types across Slack, Jira, on-call, AI and incident operations. Condition-based alert routes and severity-based retrospective routing add further event-driven rules. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow engine in practice; the community comment calling it a 'glorified Slack workflow' only questions its value and does not contradict the capability.
